festivals.name: Losar
festivals.description: Tibetan New Year celebration marking the beginning of the lunar calendar with traditional dances, prayers, and feasts.
festivals.significance: Most important festival in Tibetan Buddhism, symbolizing renewal and purification

festivals.name: Saga Dawa
festivals.description: Triple blessed day celebrating Buddha's birth, enlightenment, and parinirvana.
festivals.significance: One of the holiest days in Buddhism when merit is multiplied

festivals.name: Pang Lhabsol
festivals.description: Unique Sikkimese festival honoring Mount Khangchendzonga as the guardian deity.
festivals.significance: Celebrates the sacred bond between Sikkim and its guardian mountain

festivals.name: Drupka Teshi
festivals.description: First sermon of Buddha at Sarnath, marking the beginning of Buddhist teachings.
festivals.significance: Turning of the Wheel of Dharma - foundation of Buddhist philosophy

festivals.name: Lhabab Duchen
festivals.description: Buddha's descent from heaven after teaching his mother dharma.
festivals.significance: One of the four great holy days in Tibetan Buddhism
traditions: Making offerings to the Three Jewels

festivals.name: Bumchu
festivals.description: Sacred water ceremony at Tashiding Monastery predicting the coming year.
festivals.significance: Ancient ritual that foretells the fortune of the coming year

calendar_info.lunar_calendar: Most festivals follow the Tibetan lunar calendar
calendar_info.weather_considerations: Mountain weather can be unpredictable during festival times
cultural_etiquette: Remove shoes before entering prayer halls
Photography may be restricted in certain areas
